common_spine.rule: Perspective changes routing, never underlying evidence.

perspectives.label: Culture + community
perspectives.boundary: Do not infer or speak for Indigenous/community viewpoints beyond evidence.

protected_invariants: Facts can change the fiction. Fiction must never quietly become fact.
Material factual claims remain traceable to evidence.
Connection is not causation without evidence.
Fiction is never market or investment evidence.
Full canonical edition and SOURCES remain accessible.

media.aoc001_existing_factual_film: legacy approved test asset; not a future-edition requirement

change_rule: Changes to evidence, fact/fiction boundaries or causal claims require explicit approval. Perspective presentation may evolve while these invariants remain intact.
